catalog.title: 1968 Seiko JDM Catalog No.2
catalog.note: Japanese domestic catalogue. Each watch is printed as ◇symbol + number with a (case–dial) code, e.g. ◇61GAW 010 (800-800); ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM style (61GAW-010; ladies' 10QS R-603), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the bracketed code. A second number marked 〃 和 is the same watch with the day in Japanese and is kept in code/notes, not as a separate record. Prices are list prices in yen per printed material/band line (SS stainless, SGP gold-plated, GC gold cap, WG/WGP/WGF white gold / plated / filled, AGF/AWGF/AWGP/ASGP/APDP/ACRP = A-grade gold-filled, white-gold, gold-plated, palladium and chrome finishes, PDP palladium-plated, STP, PC plastic; WP water-proof; MB metal bracelet, LB leather band — the catalogue prints no bracelet part codes; F as printed). Movement calibers are not printed except where the symbol is the caliber (2519, 2539, 1944, 6159, 6618); the symbol's leading digits only name the movement family (61 = 61xx, 56 = 56xx).
catalog.method: vision extraction in-harness (no paid API): pages rendered, read by Claude subagents writing batch JSON. Re-verified Oct 2026 against 250 DPI renders: every caption re-read at full resolution on per-record contact sheets (ref, printed code, case–dial code, jewels, every price line with its material/band, specs, water resistance); records rebuilt one per pictured watch (264 → 258: 32 variant-number lines folded into their watch, 26 missed watches added incl. the 89ST stopwatches and railway pocket watches), stopwatch records moved off page 0 to their real pages, misread symbols fixed (61-SD/51-S → 61-5D/51-5 etc.), inferred calibers removed, and every watch given its own photo box.
